method: Production WMS runtime, ledger, courier and actual warehouse collision cloned into isolated PhysX at 20 ms. Workflow scans use decoded-label fixture input; carton placement is explicit test setup followed by real physics settling.
scope: Physical support, workflow transactions, exact manifests and courier departure. Native handheld input, camera framing and optical label occlusion remain separate browser and scanner checks. The open source scene is never changed.

checks.name: career opening and scene-local initialization
checks.expectation: The empty career has one account, physical bins and example documents without changing the authored scene.

checks.name: Sandbox stock occupies its labelled bins
checks.expectation: One hundred real cartons, eight items, five rack rows and separate receiving/staging bins reconcile with opening WMS stock.

checks.name: manager creates repeatable validated documents
checks.expectation: All eight catalogue items support fresh purchase and sales documents. Invalid quantities reject atomically and drafts do not move stock or money.

checks.name: purchase creates a real unreceived delivery
checks.expectation: Booking debits once; the physical driver delivers exactly the ordered cartons, which remain Expected until scanned receiving.

checks.name: receipt requires a correct PO and supported carton
checks.expectation: Wrong PO, held, airborne and kinematic cartons cannot be received; a supported duplicate scan cannot receive twice.

checks.name: physical movement alone does not transfer inventory
checks.expectation: A misplaced carton remains in its recorded bin and raises an exception; source/carton/destination confirmation reconciles only actual supported placement.

checks.name: pick work validates exact stock and staging
checks.expectation: Release allocates real source stock, wrong cartons and missing staging reject, and completed picks book one collection without paying.

checks.name: loaded stock needs scanner authorization and offsite departure
checks.expectation: Physically loaded boxes alone cannot leave; scan-confirmed exact loading and cleared ramp authorize the real courier, then one offsite payment posts.

checks.name: returned dispatch stock can be picked again
checks.expectation: A loaded carton returns through the recorded dispatch bin, invalidates shipment authorization and appears as outstanding pick work.
